batch: BATCH 2 — Database and Ingestion Idempotency & Commercial Price Evidence Taxonomy

fixes.description: Multi-source ingestion scripts (ingest_multisource_pilot.py and ingest_new_research.py) deduplicated existing records and enforced check-before-insert semantics across DataSources, CollectionJobs, CollectionRuns, SourceRecords, Products, ProductOffers, BundleOffers, and EvidenceLinks. Fixed duplicate trends_door_draft_stopper in SQLite winhunter.db.

Introduced PriceEvidenceType enum separating OBSERVED_RETAIL_LISTING_PRICE, OBSERVED_CHECKOUT_PRICE, ADVERTISED_PRICE_ONLY, SUPPLIER_LISTED_PRICE, SCENARIO_PRICE, and UNKNOWN. Removed Google Trends search URL as product offer price; linked Holikme Amazon US benchmark listing ($19.99) and modeled 2-unit scenario bundle ($39.99).
